content: React touch events for swipe detection require no library. Pattern: useRef for touchStartX, onTouchStart stores e.touches[0].clientX, onTouchEnd computes delta = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX, threshold 50px triggers left (next day) or right (prev day). React synthetic events onTouchStart/onTouchEnd/onTouchMove are cross-browser consistent. changedTouches[0].clientX is the correct API for touchend (not touches[0] which may be empty). Use useCallback for memoized handlers. Entire hook is ~15 lines, zero deps. Alternative: Pointer Events API (onPointerDown/onPointerUp) works for both mouse and touch, simpler API but slightly less universal on older devices. Touch approach is correct for this project's mobile-only swipe requirement.
